things that will make you
dangerously intelligent

the why habit

whenever something works, from a fridge to a joke, ask yourself why it works. people who ask why all day end up understanding the world while everyone else just uses it.

reading outside your field

once a week, read one article from a field you know nothing about: medicine, law, design. the best ideas come from mixing worlds that most people keep separate.

a notebook of questions

carry a small notebook and write down every question that pops into your head. at the end of the week, look up three of them. curiosity only pays when you follow it.

five minutes of something hard

spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson that stretches you: a theory in physics, an idea in philosophy, an economic concept. small doses of hard things sharpen your mind every week.

watching experts work

watch one video a week of a real expert doing their job: a chef, a surgeon, a carpenter. seeing how masters think is a shortcut that most people never think to take.
